label: Auto keyframe
//: cycle 360 (as v1): the hand ends one whole turn on
intent: Auto-key is switched on and records a key. Light: the crown is pressed in and springs back; a beat later the keyed hand sweeps one full clockwise turn, lands on its key past twelve with a dead stop and ticks back. Strong: a deeper press that jolts twice, the hand winds back against the turn, then sweeps the full turn faster, overshooting farther and settling in decaying ticks. The case never moves.

crown-stem.//: Solid: v1's stem runs on to the case (6 to 9.5 at 2.6), as a filled round-capped bar

needle.//: Solid: v1 cuts a 1.6-wide slot for the hand, so its Solid shape (the knockout) is that slot

needle.rotate.//: one clockwise turn from the press; it ends a whole turn on, so the rest is unchanged
